purpose: Make convergence capable of subtraction without confusing deletion with progress.

game_donors.donor_mechanism: survey interconnected subsystems/hazards before dismantling; extract valuable material with tool-specific cuts
game_donors.transfer: SURVEY → ISOLATE → SALVAGE → CUT → VERIFY → RETURN
game_donors.residue: fiction, debt economy, spaceship skin and destructive spectacle do not transfer

game_donors.donor_mechanism: restoration succeeds by leaving a functioning ecology rather than permanent construction machinery
game_donors.transfer: temporary scaffolding must have an exit condition; success may reduce visible machinery
game_donors.residue: ecology simulation, biome content and environmental scoring do not transfer

laws: DELETE != CONVERGE. Removal is lawful only after identity, inbound dependence, children, authority and residue are surveyed.
SALVAGE MECHANISM BEFORE CONTAINER. Preserve the transferable invariant/proof/provenance before removing a superseded surface.
FROZEN_DONOR != DEBT. Recovery artifacts may remain deliberately addressable without competing for CURRENT attention.
ALIAS != DEAD. Compatibility addresses may carry external bookmarks and are not retired from internal silence alone.
TEMPORARY MECHANISM OWES AN EXIT CONDITION. Candidate/parked/experiment surfaces enter SALVAGE_REVIEW rather than permanent accretion.
RETIRE_CANDIDATE != DELETE AUTHORITY. The audit never mutates files; a separate bounded change must perform and prove any cut.
CUT MUST RETURN. A retirement change names removed addresses, preserved donors, redirects if any, broken-reference proof and reversal path.

classifications.KEEP_DONOR: Frozen/recovered donor; retain as archive capability.
classifications.KEEP_COMPAT: Alias/redirect; retain unless an explicit compatibility migration proves retirement.
classifications.SALVAGE_REVIEW: Temporary/parked/experiment; identify what survives and whether the container still earns its surface.
classifications.RETIRE_CANDIDATE: Explicit superseded/deprecated/retired/removed signal with no detected current/structural/runtime blocker.
classifications.BLOCKED: Retirement signal exists but children, aliases, CURRENT or live references remain.

safety.absence_of_internal_reference: not proof of zero external dependency
